register_model: register a model in the MODEL_REGISTRY with org, base_name, version, size, and quant_type
register_models: register multiple model variants from a ModelMeta including sizes, instruct_tags, and quant_types
check_model_info: check Hugging Face model metadata for a given model_id and return model info or warning
construct_model_name: construct a full model name from base_name, version, size, quant_type, and instruct_tag
build_model_info: build a ModelInfo dataclass instance with org, base_name, version, size, and optional metadata
